### Shopify Magic for product descriptions

Included with Shopify

#### Write compelling product descriptions in seconds

---

#### How it works

##### Use directly in your Shopify admin

Your Shopify plan includes free AI-generated product descriptions, no apps required.

##### Get compelling descriptions from a few keywords

List a few product details to generate unique descriptions that make your products stand out.

##### Pick the tone to match your brand

Select from a set of predefined tones of voice, or set your own to reflect your unique brand personality.

##### Easily edit or generate new versions

Create as many versions as you need to get the right fit before publishing.

---

#### What’s in the box

#### Product content features

Shopify has everything you need to generate engaging product descriptions. Product content apps may offer features for generating and managing additional content types, and for optimizing SEO for your content.

View all product content apps
